Frequently Asked Questions

How do I place an order on this page?

Add products to “My List” and tap “Order on WhatsApp”, or use the WhatsApp button on any product. We confirm stock, delivery time and the final total with you personally before dispatch.

Why are there two prices on every product?

The main price is in Pakistani Rupees (PKR). The dollar price is the same amount converted at the USD/PKR rate shown at the top of this page. When the live market rate loads, USD prices update automatically; if it cannot load, the page clearly labels the fallback rate of Rs 280 = $1 instead of pretending it is live.

Can I pay online by card, JazzCash or Easypaisa here?

Not on this public browsing page. Online payments are not live here — Cash on Delivery is the payment method we confirm on WhatsApp or by phone.

Who sells the products on Kashif Traders?

Only Kashif Traders. This is a single-seller store: every product listed here is stocked and sold by Kashif Traders itself, and we handle your order, delivery questions and returns directly.

What if my product arrives damaged?

Message us on WhatsApp or call +92 309 6929813 with your order details and a photo. We will arrange a replacement or refund according to the return terms confirmed with your order.
